stories.headline: FTC emerges as main consumer-protection watchdog in D.C.
stories.body: As other federal agencies retreat, the Federal Trade Commission has become the only active consumer watchdog under the Trump administration, overseeing big-tech firms and digital payments.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang exit odds are low on prediction markets after Nvidia probe
stories.body: Prediction markets traders price relatively low odds that the Nvidia CEO will depart in the near term.
